description:
Query parameters for ``GET /v1/complaints``.

All filters are optional and combined with AND semantics. Pagination is
cursor-based; institutions pass the ``next_cursor`` echoed in the
previous response.

institution_id.description: Filter by institution. SBS supervisor users may scope queries across institutions; institution users see only their own.
institution_id.title: Institution Id

next_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass the value from the previous response's `next_cursor` field. Omit on the first page.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
